tickets.title: Product families: simple products linked by attributes (replaces configurables)
tickets.scope: The new store has no configurable products: every variant is a simple product, and siblings are found by shared attributes. Build one service that, for a product, returns its family and the axes it varies by: configuration (sofa modules and seaters), fabric / colour (today `colour_super_sku`), size, chaise side, comfort. Each sibling: name of the option, URL, swatch image, Quick Ship or Made To Order, lead time. Used by the PDP pickers, the PLP card ("N colours available") and structured data. Attribute names come from the PIM plan (`elme-product-data`). FE-28 was written for configurables; rewrite its scope to read from this service.
tickets.ref: Production https://www.elmeliving.com/riley-apt-muse-flax-chaise-left-arm-facing-sofa-module.html (Configuration, Select Color). Old code: `Overdose_ConfigurableByAttribute`, `Bart_ConfigurableByAttribute`; search m2-bart-group for `family-configurator` and `swa__`.
qa: A product with no siblings returns an empty family, and the page shows no pickers
Siblings come back in a fixed order with name, URL and swatch image
Disabled or not visible siblings are left out
No configurable product is needed for any picker to work
Unit tests cover the grouping by each attribute

tickets.title: PDP: sofa family configurator (Configuration picker + See all configurations)
tickets.scope: On modular sofa pages: a "Configuration:" row with the current module named and a slider of sibling configurations (image + name; 21 on Riley Apt: modules, armchair, ottoman, 2 to 6 seaters), previous / next buttons, and "See all configurations" that opens a dialog with the full grid ("Select a configuration below", current one marked). Picking one opens that product page. Data from the product families service.
tickets.ref: Production https://www.elmeliving.com/riley-apt-muse-flax-chaise-left-arm-facing-sofa-module.html. Old markup: classes `family-configurator`, `family-popup`, `config-item` in theme `Bart/el`.
qa: Current configuration is marked in the row and in the dialog
Slider works with swipe on the phone and with the keyboard on desktop
Dialog closes with Esc and the close button, focus returns to "See all configurations"
A product without a family shows no Configuration row
Guests see no prices in the dialog

tickets.title: PDP: fabric swatches with Quick Ship / Made To Order groups and the MTO swatch modal
tickets.scope: "Select Color:" block on sofa pages: the current fabric named, swatches (image + name; 31 on Riley Apt) in two groups, Quick Ship and "Made To Order: With you in 14 weeks", with an info tooltip whose text comes from a CMS block. A Quick Ship swatch opens the sibling product. A Made To Order swatch opens a modal first (large fabric image, name, lead time, confirm) and then the sibling product. Port the modal as it works on production for a logged-in trade customer.
tickets.ref: Production https://www.elmeliving.com/riley-apt-muse-flax-chaise-left-arm-facing-sofa-module.html. Old markup: classes `swa__group--mto`, `swa__item--show-popup`, `swatches_data` in theme `Bart/el`.
qa: Current fabric is marked and named
Quick Ship and Made To Order groups each show only their fabrics; an empty group is hidden
MTO swatch opens the modal; confirm goes to that product, Esc closes it
Lead time text and tooltip come from admin, not from the template
Swatches wrap without horizontal scroll at 390 px

tickets.title: Made to Order sofas category: MTO label, colour count on the card, State selector
tickets.scope: /made-to-order-sofas.html: the card shows "Made To Order" where other cards show stock, and "N colours available" when the product has fabric siblings. The toolbar has a State selector (Automatic, NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, NT, ACT) with Reset. Find in the old code what State changes (stock, lead time or freight) and port it; if the new stock source does not need it, record that in the ticket and leave it out.
qa: MTO products show "Made To Order", never "In Stock" or "Low Stock"
Colour count matches the number of fabric siblings
State choice is kept while browsing and Reset clears it
Guests see "Sign in to see pricing" on every card

tickets.title: Launch SEO: XML sitemap, robots.txt, 301 redirects from the old URLs
tickets.scope: Production sitemap lists 20,214 URLs. Generate the new XML sitemap (products, categories, CMS) on a schedule; robots.txt with the production rules that still apply; a redirect map so every old indexed URL answers 301 to its new page (products and categories whose URL key changes, removed CMS pages, old /blog/* URLs that are still in the sitemap but answer 404, `catalog/product/view/id/*`). Check the map with a script against the old sitemap before launch.
qa: Every URL of the old sitemap answers 200 or one 301 to a 200 page
No redirect chains or loops
Sitemap holds only indexable, canonical URLs
robots.txt blocks account, cart, checkout and search result pages
